payload.name: Foot-in-the-door technique
payload.fact: The foot-in-the-door technique involves obtaining compliance with a small request to increase the likelihood of compliance with a subsequent, larger request.
payload.boundary: Social compliance procedures. REVERSED for individuals with low preference for consistency (PFC): when their prior helpfulness is made salient, low-PFC individuals show a reverse foot-in-the-door effect instead (giving LESS after a small prior compliance). See effect-id-12-reverse-foot-in-the-door-effect-8ec2c49463ca (rejected MIS_ANCHORED) — its finding is preserved here as a boundary condition rather than as its own effect.

provenance.title: Reciprocal concessions procedure for inducing compliance: The door-in-the-face technique.
provenance.quote_or_locus: They demonstrated that obtaining a person's compliance with a small request substantially increases the likelihood of that person's compliance with a subsequent, larger request

provenance.title: Effectiveness of Multiple Request Strategies: A Synthesis of Research Results
provenance.quote_or_locus: Foot in the door and door in the face have been cited frequently as effective strategies for gaining compliance with behavioral requests
